# TopologicalResilienceIndex

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A quantitative measure of a power grid's ability to maintain stability under perturbations, derived from its network topology. Gives TCC a concrete metric to optimize network architectures for robustness, applicable beyond power grids to general computing topologies.
